topics.title: Specialized Agent Orchestration & API Reference
topics.shortDesc: Comprehensive API references explaining how to define custom agents and coordinate handoffs.
topics.fullDesc: Create clear, thorough guidelines for registering new agent profiles, declaring their tool payloads, and setting coordination topologies using the Express 5.1 API endpoints.

topics.title: AES-256-GCM Secure Encryption Guide
topics.shortDesc: Step-by-step developer guide on key rotation and secret storage workflows.
topics.fullDesc: Explain the cryptographic architecture of Valtheron. Provide guidelines on how components should securely request decrypted secrets and handle initialization vectors (IVs).

topics.title: Express 5.1 Routers & SQLite Concurrency Locks
topics.shortDesc: Audit the Express 5.1 middleware performance under concurrent agent execution loads.
topics.fullDesc: Check for SQLite database locks when 50+ agents are spinning up, writing logs, and reading model contexts concurrently. Suggest robust connection pool tunings or write-ahead logging (WAL) toggles.

topics.title: Audit Trail Signature Verification Middleware
topics.shortDesc: Evaluate the integrity checks applied to secure WORM log tables.
topics.fullDesc: Assess whether audit logs can be easily falsified if a container is compromised. Design a HMAC or cryptographic chaining verification script to check the validity of logs.

topics.title: Multi-Agent Parallel Context handoff Tests
topics.shortDesc: Design strict test cases for state conflicts in parallel agent execution.
topics.fullDesc: Develop a suite of automated unit tests using Vitest to simulate a multi-agent transaction where one agent crashes mid-process. Ensure state rollback is verified.

topics.title: MFA Token Expiry & Re-Auth Edge Cases
topics.shortDesc: Mock the TOTP MFA engine to test verification failures during agent actions.
topics.fullDesc: Write tests covering scenario paths where an OTP token expires precisely as an agent triggers a highly privileged execution, verifying secure aborts.

topics.title: Developer Local Environment Seeding Quickstart
topics.shortDesc: Create an interactive CLI script to set up mock SQLite databases with dummy agents.
topics.fullDesc: Build and document a streamlined setup workflow so fresh contributors get the Express backend running and 290 mocked agents loaded with a single terminal command.

topics.title: PR Quality & Cryptography Standard Checklist
topics.shortDesc: Formulate a self-assessment checklist that pull requests must pass before review.
topics.fullDesc: Consolidate coding styles, dependency rules, security practices, and testing goals into an interactive Markdown file embedded inside the repo structure.

topics.title: SQLite to PostgreSQL Migration Layer
topics.shortDesc: Draft database adapter abstractions and initial migration SQL schemas for Postgres.
topics.fullDesc: Plan how to upgrade Valtheron's storage layer to robust relational PostgreSQL for production releases while supporting zero-config SQLite for swift local trials.

topics.title: Kubernetes Pod Isolation & Helm Deployments
topics.shortDesc: Brainstorm Helm charts and container manifest structure for Kubernetes deployment.
topics.fullDesc: Detail how specialized agents can be scheduled inside dedicated Kubernetes worker namespaces, managing networking and ingress routes safely.

topics.title: SSO/OIDC & Enterprise RBAC Integration
topics.shortDesc: Integrate Google/Okta Single Sign-On and Role-Based Access Controls.
topics.fullDesc: Map out the authentication flow redirects, token verifications, and agent permission sets to integrate with enterprise user registries securely.
